headline: [Indian stocks] Last trading day of the month also falls; largest monthly drop in six months, all sector indices down
summary: Indian stocks fell on the last trading day of the month, with the Sensex 30 down 0.067%. The benchmark posted its largest monthly decline since March as foreign investors pulled out.
why: The BSE Sensex is India's benchmark equity index, tracking large listed companies whose performance reflects the broader domestic economy.
why_moved: Inflation concerns tied to high oil prices and interest rate hikes by major countries led foreign investors to pull out. The Sensex recorded its largest monthly decline since March.
